settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• Mature skin in need of firming and rejuvenation
  • Individuals with dry, dull, or uneven skin tone
  • Those experiencing loss of elasticity or sagging
  • Anyone looking for a preventative anti-aging routine
  • All skin types, including sensitive skin

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
• Use after MyoLift’s microcurrent treatment
  • May also be used without microcurrent. Simply apply nightly to clean, dry skin

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Hydration: Hyaluronic Acid, Glycerin, and Aqua plump the skin and reduce dryness-related wrinkles.
  • Collagen Boost: Copper Peptides and Polypeptides enhance firmness and elasticity.
  • Antioxidant Protection: Vitamin E, Neroli, and Zinc guard against free radical damage.
  • Exfoliation and Renewal: Willow Bark promotes smoother, brighter skin.
  • Healing and Repair: Zinc and Copper Peptides support skin recovery and health.

settings.title: Ingredient List
settings.content: Aqua Filtered Water, Copper Peptides, Polypeptides, Hyaluronic Acid, Zinc, Tocopheryl, Acetate (Vitamin E), Vegetable Glycerin, Carbomer, Citrus, Aurantium Amara (Neroli), Salix Alba (Willow Bark Extract), Phenoxyethanol

settings.heading: Here’s how Copper Peptide works
settings.section_content: Copper peptides are powerful skin rejuvenators, responsible for collagen synthesis and stabilization. They restore firmness, rebuild elasticity, and soften fine lines and wrinkles, working deep within the skin for visible anti-aging benefits.

settings.heading: More-in-one Serum
settings.image_content:
• Provides skin with a hydrating balance which significantly reduces the loss of cutaneous elasticity.
  • Soothes irritation, and prevents premature skin aging.
  • Gives the skin a healthy and youthful look.

The properties of copper peptides, polypeptides, and hyaluronic acid present in this Anti-Aging Peptide Serum for face help to remove fine lines and wrinkles from the face, neck, eyes, and smile lines.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: How do I know Copper Peptide Serum is for me?
settings.text1: If you’re looking to improve and maintain your skin’s plump, dewy look while targeting early signs of aging, then this super blue serum is for you!
settings.title2: What are the benefits of using the Copper Peptide Serum?
settings.text2: The Copper Peptide Serum enhances skin elasticity, hydration, and firmness while supporting collagen production. It helps reduce fine lines and wrinkles, promotes cell regeneration, and improves overall skin texture for a youthful, radiant glow.
settings.title3: Do I use it in my morning or night routine?
settings.text3: You can use the serum both morning and night. Apply it after cleansing and before your moisturizer to maximize hydration and anti-aging benefits.
settings.title4: How can I pair it with a microcurrent device?
settings.text4: Apply a thin layer of the serum before using your microcurrent device to enhance conductivity and boost absorption. Follow with a conductive gel for optimal results.
settings.title5: I am a mom-to-be. Can I use this serum?
settings.text5: We recommend consulting with your doctor before using any new skincare product during pregnancy. While our serum is formulated with skin-loving ingredients, it’s always best to confirm its suitability with a healthcare professional.
